correctness.rationale: For C2, averaging over the whole group gives O=(P+Q)/2; summing subgroup averages adds the trivial subgroup term P to give F=(3P+Q)/2. The displayed edge lists make (0 1) a nonidentity automorphism and its orbit quotient has a loop contributed by edge (0,1) in both examples. Duplicate quotient edges impose duplicate constraints and can be collapsed. A set partition into k color classes, t of which contain an edge or loop, contributes (x-y) falling t times (x-t) falling (k-t): assign distinct unrestricted colors to the t classes, then assign the other classes distinct unused colors. An independent sparse integer polynomial calculation gives P_A-P_B=-2T and Q_A-Q_B=6T, so F agrees and O_A-O_B=2T, with value 64 at (3,1). Independent vertex augmentation, with canonicalization over permutations ordered by degree, generated 2,4,11,34,156,1044 unlabeled graphs on 2 through 7 vertices. Deleting a vertex from any graph and relabeling the remainder to its representative proves completeness of this extension generator. All 5,823 nonidentity involutory automorphisms were tested, with 2,680 distinct 3P+Q keys and no equal keys with distinct P+Q. The generator includes disconnected graphs; orders zero and one admit no faithful action. Thus the result does not rest on the frozen graph-atlas dependency or finite evaluation of polynomials.
